content.short: Minterest is a DeFi lending protocol on Mantle that captures 100% of protocol revenue  including liquidation profits  and redistributes it to governance participants.
content.description: Minterest is a unique DeFi lending protocol that captures all value generated by the protocol  including liquidation profits typically extracted by third-party bots  and redistributes it entirely to users who participate in governance through a buyback and distribute model. This creates strong incentives for long-term token holding and active protocol governance. Minterest also features protocol-managed automated liquidations rather than relying on external liquidators, and is deployed on Mantle.
